direct_answer: [Saved Reference Analysis] Inspect samples [220..480] (7.33s–16.00s video time) first. Episode 'teleop_demo_episode_000001' is a teleoperation demonstration where action.* represents human 'leader_command' targets. In this interval, state.wrist_flex moves from -31.52 deg to -46.55 deg (min -46.55 deg, max -9.54 deg) with state-minus-action mean_signed_diff=+1.72 deg (max_abs_diff=9.89 deg at sample 293); state.gripper transitions from 51.91 to 36.77 (range 36.77..52.30) with state-minus-action mean_signed_diff=+6.24 and max_abs_diff=8.43 at sample 251 (8.37s video time). Sampled top and wrist frames ([220, 307, 393, 480]) document the workspace and end-effector posture consistent with the supplied 'success' (every demonstration in the dataset is a success) annotation, while physical root causes (motor torque saturation, friction/slip, or sub-frame contact onset) remain explicitly unverified.
